source.heading: Part IV: Autonomous Actors > Behavior Rules

rows.name: Consolidator
rows.rule: Secures what it holds. Acts against another faction only if that faction threatened it in the last Report.

rows.name: Aggressor
rows.rule: Pushes toward its objective by the most direct means. Never holds two turns running.

rows.name: Opportunist
rows.rule: Targets the faction lowest on the Standing list.

rows.name: Balancer
rows.rule: Targets the faction highest on the Standing list.

rows.name: Reactor
rows.rule: Holds until acted upon. Then targets the faction that last affected it.

rows.name: Schemer
rows.rule: Acts on odd turns, holds on even turns. Keeps deals only while they serve it.
